exposure: Specific types of surgical procedures (e.g., hip prosthesis, coronary artery bypass)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of patients undergoing 56,617 surgical procedures in 116 hospitals across 25 Latin-American, Asian, Eastern-European, and Middle-Eastern countries.
finding: Surgical site infection rates for various procedures were significantly higher in low-resource countries (INICC data) compared to high-income counterparts (CDC/NHSN data).
country: Argentina, Bahrain, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Egypt, Honduras, India, Kosovo, Kuwait, Lebanon, Mexico, Mongolia, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, Turkey, Venezuela, Vietnam
